_comment: Hand-checked reader benchmark truth for example-drawings/shaft_detail.png.
Phase F, 2026-08-14: the second independent rotation-body ground-truth
case — before this, eval_cad_readers.py had exactly one (spindle_v10),
so no reader change could be measured beyond that single sheet.
This drawing dimensions three step diameters (Ø30h6/Ø50h6/Ø30k6), an
overall length (840) and a partial length (220), but does NOT
independently dimension each step's own length or the keyway's
width/length beyond its labelled depth — those fields are deliberately
absent here rather than invented; score_parameters simply excludes an
absent field from its denominator (see _parameter_groups), it does not
fail on it. This is a genuinely solid shaft (no bore, confirmed by both
the drawing itself and detect_axial_hatching finding no hatching).
